scheme_name: Opening And Running Junior Colleges For VJNT Students Run By Voluntary Agencies
other_conditions: Students must belong to the VJNT (Vimukta Jatis and Nomadic Tribes) category
Voluntary agency must be operating a secondary Ashram School
The secondary school result should not be below 60%
Voluntary agencies must be economically sound to run junior colleges
Required infrastructure such as building, water supply, and electricity must be available
Most of the population near the school should be VJNT
There should be no other junior colleges around the Ashram school
The voluntary agency must have no pending disputes or court matters
benefits_summary: Academic education, free lodging and boarding, medical facilities, bedding, clothing, uniforms, and educational supplies are provided to VJNT students in junior colleges.
